description: London Reservoir Levels is a dataset listed in London Datastore, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Thames Water via Environement Agency. Table showing daily Reservoir levels in London since 1989 as percentage of usable or deployable capacity in the Lower Lee Group and Lower Thames Group reservoirs. Usable or deployable capacity excludes water normally left in a reservoir for environmental or emergency contingency measures. View Environment Agency website. Coverage: Thames Water via Environement Agency. The publisher named on the listing is Thames Water via Environement Agency. Its keywords include reservoirs, capacity, resources, water. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence v2. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-london-datastore.
